name: Einar
source:
Einar is a traveling herbalist. She wishes to help people with her herbalism. She's a stern and cynical person despite her caring nature, but she wasn't always this way. The death of her mother changed her. As she gets to know Ailis and Cerise she starts to lighten up a little.

[From [url=https://cosmic-latte.itch.io/starlit-flowers]itch.io[/url]]
